tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Sustained follow-through and Break of Structure (BOS) confirmation above 61800.

tracked_patterns.name: Symmetrical Triangle
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price forming lower highs since 62000 peak and higher lows since ~60800, creating converging trendlines near current price 61500.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Breakout above 62000 or breakdown below 60800 required for confirmation.

tracked_patterns.name: Head and Shoulders

tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Decisive close below neckline (~60800-61000) to confirm reversal.

tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Price retest of the block zone for confirmation of support.
